correctness.rationale: The jump-2/3 path bijection proves the all-labeling pairwise reachability criterion. A five-state DFA recognizes all maximal-independent-set words. An inductively correct subset-family automaton has exactly 28 reachable states and a validated six-state stable quotient, giving an exact transfer series. Algebra derives the displayed rational function and nonnegative binomial coefficient formula, with proper n=0 normalization and n=1 boundary. The standalone checker reconstructs the entire finite certificate, exhaustively compares all 16,382 support tests through n=13, and verifies coefficient identity through n=100; finite tests are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result determines every cardinality of shattered supports for all path lengths, and independently identifies each face by a polynomial number of avoidant reachability checks. The extremal count 2^k at order 3k−1 and a pure/nonpure boundary are exact structural outcomes, not automatic consequences of known VC dimension. It provides an efficient self-contained automaton and reproducible infinite counting formula for a canonical independent-domination hypothesis family. The general induced-matching VC upper bound in the 2024 literature does not compute this finer face enumerator.
